highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings significant performance gains and WASM support for .NET 11 on Emscripten 5.0.6.
highlights_body: Hot colour-conversion and HarfBuzz text paths are ported to allocation-free managed code, eliminating per-call heap pressure on rendering hot loops. The WASM build adopts the exnref exception-handling model required by .NET 11, and Skia m151 upstream stability fixes are included.

bullets.detail: Multiple waves of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes merged, plus the initial m151 milestone bump, landing engine-level rendering and text stability improvements.
SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT was inadvertently removed during an upstream Skia sync, causing CPU raster rendering to regress. It has been restored.

bullets.lead: SKColor hex parsing optimized with Span overloads
bullets.detail: SKColor.Parse/TryParse now accept ReadOnlySpan<char>, avoiding a string allocation when parsing colours from substrings or stack-allocated buffers.

bullets.lead: SKColor and SKPMColor conversions ported to managed code
bullets.detail: The SKColor↔SKColorF and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply operations are now implemented in managed integer math, eliminating P/Invoke round-trips for these common hot-path operations.
The unnecessary unsafe modifier is removed, improving interoperability with assemblies that do not permit unsafe code.

bullets.lead: Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed
bullets.detail: The overload accepting SKData and a crop rectangle leaked the native image object when the crop was applied. The handle is now properly released on all code paths.
New static libraries built with Emscripten 5.0.6 and the exnref exception-handling model are added, with a CI test job to catch regressions on future .NET 11 WASM builds.

bullets.lead: Skia submodule updated to drop SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition warning
bullets.detail: A macro redefinition compiler warning on WASM builds is eliminated by bumping the Skia submodule.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for .NET 11 and visual regression test harness

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release candidate delivering the final m151 upstream stability fixes, the CPU raster regression fix, and performance infrastructure additions.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Performance sprint: HarfBuzzSharp hot paths ported to allocation-free managed code, SKColor parsing optimized with Span overloads, SKShaper glyph reads made zero-copy, and the release-notes pipeline rebuilt as a deterministic CI stage.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line with the initial Skia m151 milestone bump and WASM submodule fix.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1: Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via a pooled UTF-8 encode path, Tag.Parse drops its per-call char[4] allocation, and WASM static libraries are updated for Emscripten 5.0.6.
